summary: ruviform-script-luau analyzer backend implementation
design initially assumed mlua as dev-dependency for coexistence testing only

mlua moved to [dependencies]: the luau*.lib static libraries the shim links are produced by mlua-sys/luau0-src build scripts and would be absent from downstream consumer link graphs as a dev-dep; Rust API remains unused

ScriptAnalyzer::analyze(&self) requires interior mutability: Mutex<AnalyzerState> serializes shim calls and carries loaded_definitions dedup set + owner_thread ThreadId; NonNull field makes Send/Sync unimplemented so owner-thread affinity is type-level
u64->usize/u64->u32 narrowing casts flagged by clippy cast_possible_truncation
all public-option narrowing uses try_from with fail-closed InvalidRequest/VersionMismatch instead of `as` casts
clippy match_same_arms fires if INTERNAL(6) and INJECTED(7) get identical explicit arms
status 7 stays on wildcard arm -> Internal; status 6 later got a dedicated arm only to carry the spec-mandated 'shim internal error' message prefix
review cycle 1 P1: cursor presence alone activated native completion even when wanted.completion=false (shim treats cursor_offset>=0 as completion request)
cursor_offset is -1 unless wanted.completion; regression test cursor_without_completion_request_stays_diagnostics_only added
review cycle 1 P2: parseable but schema-invalid shim JSON (missing/non-array diagnostics or completions) silently became empty successful results

parse_analyze_json now requires top-level object + diagnostics array + completions array when requested; violations -> AnalyzerError::Internal; unit tests cover null/array/string/number/missing-field shapes
review cycle 1 P2: newline semantics diverged — Luau Lexer isNewline counts only '\n' (Lexer.cpp:286) while shim offsetToPosition and Rust position_offset also counted lone '\r'
both offsetToPosition (C++) and position_offset (Rust) now count '\n' only; spec/design/test-spec/README synced; end-to-end CR/LF diagnostic offset test added
review cycle 2 P2 (Reviewer B): Luau CheckResult.timeoutHits was dropped by the shim — module_time_limit_sec (default 5.0s) timeouts returned partial/empty diagnostics as Ok success
shim returns status 6 (Internal) when timeoutHits is non-empty; verified deterministically with module_time_limit_sec=MIN_POSITIVE + 200-local module; negative/NaN limits rejected at connect

review cycle 2 P3 batch: non-object diagnostics entries silently skipped; present-but-garbage range/position fabricated (0,0,0); position_offset col clamp could cross into next line; load_definition left globalTypes unfrozen on exception; kLuauVersion hardcoded vs luau0-src drift unenforced

all addressed: entry-level Internal, position Option propagation, col clamped to line end + saturating add, freeze-in-catch for load_definition, REVISION-tag consistency test; residual P3s recorded in evidence (VersionMismatch field naming, impl_version drift, accumulate typedef semantics)

add_type_definition redefinition semantics verified empirically: Luau loadDefinitionFile overwrites global bindings by declared name -> last-write-wins; pinned by type-annotation mismatch test and documented in README
Cargo.lock diff is exactly one new [[package]] ruviform-script-luau stanza (11 lines); mlua/luau0-src/serde_json/cc versions all pre-existing in lock
